name: MapScreen - JustArrived
description: The moment this feature is for: someone typed an idea, pressed return, and arrived at a map nobody is working on. The handoff band leads the page with what to do about that, and the map they just made stays visible underneath it - which is the whole argument for a band rather than a takeover. The band keeps its natural height and the workspace takes the remainder, so a short viewport scrolls the map instead of crushing it.
